reviews.text: [quote=BlueRibbonCollectors] Follow for more reviews & recommendations https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44970186/ [/quote] This game definitely has potential to be a great bullet hell game and it's only in early access as of writing this review. Loads of classes to choose from the further you progress in the game. Plenty of different style weapons to hack and slash through the never ending dungeons of Letter Lancers. Choose your path, either through the regular mode or take your chance at the daily high-scores with the daily dungeons! It offers a 4-Player couch co-op to play with your friends (online co-op would also be a great addition to this). I will say there are plenty of things the game could work on. The dungeons really are never ending, i felt like i was doing the same play through for ages and i couldn't even reach the end. This really is a grind, and for me i'm down for that but i can see others being put off because of this. Overall, it's pretty good, plenty to do & work towards and i'll for sure keep playing it for a while!

Every indie should look at this game as a benchmark. Great character and weapon variety, performance is good, devs are responsive and they also didn't yank the demo when the game released. Most importantly, this game delivers a rewarding experience, considering how many others end up being completely watered down to appease all of the unskilled CUPCAKES pining for auto-everything. Attacks are a mix of auto + button press, but it's still challenging and very fun. edit - wanted to also add that you should ignore the 2 negative reviews stating this game is designed for group/co-op play. There are 2 achievements requiring multiplayer, the rest can all be complete solo. I've completed multiple runs solo and unlocked all but one character playing solo, so these reviews are wrong. I've also played the game co-op locally with a friend. The game does an excellent job supporting same-screen local co-op (aka couch co-op).

Saw some reviews about this game not being made for solo players. Let me share my experience. I played the prologue of this game for almost 5 hours, and then when it was released, I played for another 5 hours, mainly doing the daily challenges, around 1-2 rounds per day. I always play SOLO, and I just reached level 2 yesterday. My trick is to play a character with a healing ability, choose a long-range weapon to keep myself safe, and upgrade abilities that let me steal HP when attacking. I also make myself tankier and increase the attack range of all my weapons. I also like the roguelike mechanics where I can upgrade my abilities. Even if I have to start over, I still get stronger. Overall, it’s all about the tactics you use when playing the game. I always play SOLO and find it lots of fun. It allows me to think strategically about how to combine character, weapons, and abilities in the game to create more chances to win. I RECOMMEND THIS GAME even if you are a SOLO player looking for purely chaotic skill-based combat, diverse abilities and skills, and hordes of enemies. Buy this game.
